cases.study_information: All molecules are the VHH-Fc constructs listed in Table9; sequence1 contains the complete tested fusion chain. Molecular names have been anonymized. The row reference is a measured reference and is not a target. All eight other rows must be predicted. The source uses transient ExpiCHO-S expression,14day culture, affinity purification and SEC polishing; culture conditions are shared within this comparison. Do not equate purified yield with solubility.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
